name: Kobrow (Germany)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kobrow (a yellow oak on green and a yellow fir on green above blue waves).
history: Municipal flag of Kobrow; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kobrow arms — oak and fir over waves
